BiblicalUsage: Chiysh is quickly, in a hurry, and it stands once in the psalm about the shortness of life. The days of our years are threescore years and ten, and it is soon cut off, and we fly away, a single word for how fast a life goes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is meant to make me count my days, because a life flies away faster than I think.
